title: Permission under zero, one and two negations
source: synthetic, generated by code with seed 7; 10 base policy clauses rendered with 0, 1 or 2 negations; gold is the code-computed parity of the negations

question.instructions: `policy` is a single policy sentence and `action` describes something a person wants to do. Read `policy` literally, including any negations it contains. Does `policy` permit the action described in `action`?

criteria.true: Read literally, `policy` says the action in `action` is allowed.
criteria.false: Read literally, `policy` says the action in `action` is not allowed.
